law.title: Required position and method of turning at intersections (5)
law.text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn where both intersecting highways are one-way, both the approach for the left turn and the left turn must be made as close as practicable to the left-hand curb or edge of the highway.

activation_conditions: the subject turns left where both intersecting highways are one-way
residue: 'as close as practicable' is a judgement element
